content_sections.heading: TMC Zonal Coordinator Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Zonal Coordinator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: TMC Zonal Coordinator Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Zonal Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Zonal Coordinator post at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 06 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Zonal Coordinator position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Zonal Coordinator role, candidates must possess a Science graduate degree along with a Master's in Public Health or a Master of Hospital Administration equivalent from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Zonal Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Zonal Coordinator position is 30 years as of 31 July 2026. No minimum age limit is specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Zonal Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Zonal Coordinator position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Zonal Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Zonal Coordinator recruitment at Tata Memorial Centre. The application process is free of cost.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Zonal Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Zonal Coordinator post at Tata Memorial Centre will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Jatni, Odisha, with the pincode 752050. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the precise venue address.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Zonal Coordinator position at Tata Memorial Centre is a contractual job. The duration of the contract is not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for more information?
faq.answer: For more details regarding the Zonal Coordinator recruitment and other opportunities, candidates can visit the official website of Tata Memorial Centre at www.actrec.gov.in.
